role: StrapRecordingCoordinator extension: arming the strap's own recording (H10 exercise / Verity offline PPI) with the rescue→clear→begin sequence, clearing/listing stored recordings, reading recording status, and the explicit Discard path.
types: StrapRecordingCoordinator: extension — start/clear/list/status/discard of on-device recordings
toplevel: SDK-dependent members are inside `#if canImport(PolarBleSdk)` blocks; without the SDK startRecording/checkRecordingStatus/stopOfflinePpiRecording/discardStoredExercises throw sdkNotAvailable and clear/check are no-ops.

flags.text: Arming leaves PolarManager.recordingState stuck at .starting when it aborts after setting it: startVeritySenseRecording sets .starting (:88) before the loop, and the H10 clear step sets .starting (:153) before the next requireArmingAllowed; a CancellationError from requireArmingAllowed (session ending / transfer started), or notConnected/featureNotReady from startOfflinePpiRecording's guards (PolarManager+VeritySense.swift:19-22) never resets it. statusOutcome leaves transitional states untouched (StrapRecordingPolicy.swift:74), so every later startDecision returns .alreadyRecording (StrapRecordingPolicy.swift:52) the Record screen's actions are disabled (RecordView+Panels.swift:580 isActionDisabled is true for .starting) and Disconnect is disabled (ConnectionPanelViews.swift:353) until some fetch settles the state.

units.does: Decides via StrapRecordingPolicy.startDecision from api/device/connection/recording state and dispatches: throws notConnected or alreadyRecording, else runs the Verity Sense or H10 start sequence; without the SDK throws sdkNotAvailable.

branches.cond: decision .notConnected (no api, no device id, or not .connected)

units.does: Arms a fresh recording: refuses (CancellationError) when arming is withdrawn; if the strap reports it is already recording, downloads that stale recording (attended budget) and hands non-empty points to onUnrecoveredDataRescued, then runs startRecording.
calls: closure:onUnrecoveredDataRescued — RRCollector.backUpRescuedRecording (RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:61) writes a RawRRBackup under a new UUID

branches.cond: strap (or fallback app flag) says a recording is running
branches.effect: true → beginTransfer + fetchRecording(recordedSince:nil, .attended), whose errors propagate and abort arming; false → straight to startRecording
true → onUnrecoveredDataRescued(stale); false → nothing backed up

flags.text: For a Verity Sense the stale fetch reads every stored offline recording (since nil) and joins them back-to-back into one series dated at the earliest (PolarManager+VeritySense.swift:90-106) and rescues it; the start sequence's rescue step (:93/:120) then reads and rescues the same recordings again. Each rescue is filed under a fresh UUID (RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:75), so Lost Sessions gets duplicate and multi-night-concatenated entries. Reachability is narrow: every production caller of startFreshRecording is H10-gated (RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift:95, WorkoutRecorder+DeviceBackup.swift:88) except the resume loop (RRCollector+PauseResume.swift:222), which only arms after .h10Recording is usable (RRCollector+OvernightArming.swift:124).

units.does: Throws CancellationError (and logs) unless stillWanted() is true, the task is not cancelled, and no transfer is in flight.

branches.effect: true → return; false → log 'Arming withdrawn' and throw CancellationError

units.does: Asks the strap whether it is recording (checkRecordingStatus); on any error logs and falls back to the app's isRecordingOnDevice flag.

branches.cond: checkRecordingStatus throws (not connected, feature not usable, BLE error)
branches.effect: error logged and swallowed; returns manager.isRecordingOnDevice, which after a relaunch is false (comment :42-46), so a running recording is then not rescued before startRecording

units.does: Verity Sense arming: requires offlineRecording usable, sets recordingState .starting, then for each StrapStartSequence step re-checks arming permission and runs rescue (fetch all offline PPI → backup), clear (only when rescue succeeded), and begin (startOfflinePpiRecording).

branches.effect: each iteration first calls requireArmingAllowed; a throw exits with recordingState left at .starting
clearExistingTolerantly('recordings') — deletes every offline PPI recording
skip the clear; the new recording starts beside the undownloaded one

flags.text: The Verity rescue downloads and backs up every stored offline recording without consulting the download ledger / isRecordingSaved, unlike the H10 path (:179-184). StrapStartSequence documents that the rescue 'downloads only what the download record says the app lacks, so it costs nothing when everything is saved'. Since the Verity keeps recordings after download (PolarManager+VeritySense.swift:84-85), every arming re-downloads last night and files it again as a new rescue backup.

units.does: Logs and runs clearAnyExistingExercises; any error is logged as a warning and swallowed so the start continues.

branches.effect: warning logged, error swallowed; for an H10 the subsequent start then fails with error 106 (comment :233)

units.does: Reads all Verity offline PPI recordings (requireEveryEntry) and passes non-empty results to onUnrecoveredDataRescued; returns true when nothing needs keeping (empty, none found, or rescued) and false when the read failed so the caller skips the clear.

branches.effect: nothing on the strap; return true

branches.cond: any other error (fetchFailed for a partial download, BLE error)
branches.effect: log warning, return false — caller leaves recordings on the strap

units.does: H10 arming: requires h10Recording usable, then for each StrapStartSequence step re-checks arming permission and runs it.

branches.effect: requireArmingAllowed before each; a throw after the clear step leaves recordingState .starting

units.does: Executes one H10 start step.

branches.effect: rescueUndownloadedH10Recordings() — throws strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording if any unsaved exercise cannot be downloaded

units.does: For every stored H10 exercise the app does not hold, downloads it by id (attended budget) and hands it to onUnrecoveredDataRescued; a failed download aborts arming with strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording.

branches.effect: log external error and throw strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording (original error discarded)

units.does: Lists stored H10 exercises and returns the ids whose start (decoded from the app's exercise id) is not saved per isRecordingSaved; undecodable ids count as unsaved.

branches.cond: decoded start exists and isRecordingSaved(start) == true
branches.effect: drop the id (nil); otherwise (undecodable or not saved) keep it for rescue

units.does: Starts the H10 exercise recording; on failure converts the error through surfaceH10StartFailure and throws the result.

branches.effect: throw await surfaceH10StartFailure(error) (strapBatteryTooLow or the original error)

units.does: Sends api.startRecording(deviceId, exerciseId: StrapExerciseDecoder.exerciseId() (timestamp id), interval 1s, sampleType .rr) and on success sets recordingState .recording and isRecordingOnDevice true.

branches.effect: throw PolarError.notConnected (then surfaced as a recordingFailed lastError)

units.does: Logs the start failure, sets recordingState .idle, and sets lastError: strapBatteryTooLow(percent: last batteryLevel) for a PFTP BATTERY_TOO_LOW refusal (returned to the caller), otherwise recordingFailed(humanized message) while returning the original error.

branches.effect: false → lastError = recordingFailed(humanized), return original error; true → lastError and return value = strapBatteryTooLow(percent:)

units.does: True when the error is BlePsFtpException.responseError whose code maps to Protocol_PbPFtpError.batteryTooLow (209).

branches.effect: false → return false; true → compare code with .batteryTooLow

units.does: Display name of the connected device type for log lines.
Clears stored recordings on the connected strap: Verity → offline PPI recordings, anything else → H10 exercises; no-op when nothing is connected or without the SDK.

branches.effect: true → clearOfflinePpiRecordings; false (H10 or nil type) → clearStoredExercises

units.does: Verity: removes every offline PPI recording when the offlineRecording feature is usable, logging how many were removed.

branches.effect: log and return without error — nothing cleared
log 'No offline PPI recordings to clear' and return; else log count

flags.text: When the Verity's offline-recording feature is not usable (or api is nil) this returns normally without clearing; discardStoredExercises (:450-452) then sets hasStoredExercise=false and storedExerciseDate=nil, so the Record screen reports the strap as discarded while its recordings are still stored.

units.does: H10: lists stored exercises and removes each one via api.removeExercise, logging; errors propagate.

branches.effect: removeExercise; first failure throws and leaves the rest

units.does: Lists the Verity's offline PPI recordings (one entry per recording) via listPpiEntries.

flags.text: listOfflinePpiRecordings is a one-line pass-through to listPpiEntries with a single caller (:385); two names for the same listing.

units.does: Collects api.listOfflineRecordings into an array, keeps only .ppi entries and dedups to one entry per recording path via StrapOfflineRecordingEntries.onePerRecording.

branches.cond: for each entry yielded by the stream

units.does: Lists PPI entries and removes each with api.removeOfflineRecord; returns how many were removed.
Collects api.listExercises(deviceId) into an array of PolarExerciseEntry.

Asks the strap whether it is recording (Verity: offline-recording status for PPI; H10: requestRecordingStatus), applies the answer to isRecordingOnDevice/recordingState via applyStatus, and returns it.

branches.cond: strapAPI nil or no device id

branches.effect: true → veritySenseRecordingStatus; false → H10 status + applyStatus

units.does: Verity: requires offlineRecording usable, reads getOfflineRecordingStatus, treats a missing .ppi key as false, applies it and returns it.

Applies StrapRecordingPolicy.statusOutcome: sets isRecordingOnDevice and moves recordingState only when the outcome names a state (.recording when ongoing; .idle when not ongoing and current was .recording).

branches.effect: assign it; nil (transitional states starting/stopping/fetching, or idle) → leave recordingState unchanged

units.does: Refreshes hasStoredExercise/storedExerciseDate from the strap: Verity via offline recordings, H10 via stored exercises; logs and returns when no device id.

branches.cond: strapAPI nil or no device id

units.does: Verity: if offlineRecording usable, lists PPI recordings and sets hasStoredExercise = non-empty and storedExerciseDate = earliest entry date; on error resets both to false/nil.

branches.effect: log and return; flags left unchanged
log; hasStoredExercise=false, storedExerciseDate=nil — a BLE error reads as 'nothing stored'

flags.text: A listing error is mapped to hasStoredExercise=false, the same state as an empty strap, so a strap that holds an undownloaded recording but answered with an error hides the Recover card until the next successful check.

units.does: H10: lists stored exercises, finds the newest by app exercise id and decodes its start date; sets hasStoredExercise = non-empty and storedExerciseDate = that start (nil when undecodable); on error resets to false/nil.

branches.effect: logs 'unknown'; storedExerciseDate nil so RRCollector.hasUnrecoveredData is false for a foreign/undecodable exercise

units.does: Verity: requires a connection and offlineRecording usable, stops the PPI offline recording, sets isRecordingOnDevice false and recordingState .idle.
Returns api.requestRecordingStatus(deviceId) (ongoing flag + entry id).

User 'Discard & Start Fresh': requires a connection, stops a running recording (bounded), deletes every stored recording via clearAnyExistingExercises, then sets hasStoredExercise false and storedExerciseDate nil.
If the app believes the strap is recording, runs stopForDiscard under StrapDeadline with the attended stop budget (45 s), timing out with fetchFailed.

branches.effect: return without asking the strap — a recording the app's flag does not know about is not stopped before the clear

flags.text: Discard trusts the app's isRecordingOnDevice flag, which startFreshRecording's own comment (:42-46) says is false after a relaunch while the strap still records; the subsequent clear then runs against a recording strap.

units.does: Stops the running recording for discard: Verity via stopOfflinePpiRecording, H10 via stopH10Recording(awaitFinalize: true, no progress, not cancellable, streamHoldsIt false).
